hypothesis: Pure listwise softmax may outperform the previously tried hybrid because the target metrics are strictly within-user ranking metrics, and the hybrid likely retained pointwise calibration pressure that hurts top-of-list ordering. Since the hybrid underperformed the baseline, this draft isolates whether removing the pointwise term lets the model focus entirely on ordering each user's impressions, potentially lifting nDCG@5 and GAUC without changing architecture or adding noisy signals.
expected_effect: Small but informative move: roughly -0.001 to +0.003 primary versus the hybrid attempt, with the upside mainly from better nDCG@5 if pure ranking pressure matters more than calibration.
decide_reason: only 2 attempts exist (< draft_count=7); drafting a fresh combination, prioritizing untried high-priority axes
